tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Capture a screenshot of a web page and return it as an image. Handles consent banners, ads, lazy-loaded images and late-rendering SPAs. Use this when the layout, styling or visual appearance is what matters; use read_page when you only need the text.

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Render a web page and return its content as clean Markdown. The page is fully rendered first - JavaScript executed, consent banners dismissed, lazy images loaded - so this works on sites that return nothing useful to a plain HTTP fetch. Prefer this over screenshot when you need to read or reason abo
